name: National Park Posters
lore: The road heads out into the great outdoors on old 1930s park and travel posters: geysers, mountains, forests, ski trails and zoo animals, each one dug out a block at a time.
sourceNote: Real 1930s WPA and travel posters from the Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs (rights advisory 'No known restrictions on publication', re-read per item); lane C's 23 picks less 2 dropped (21 levels) (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/09-national-park-posters/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace aa512c7), each a crop of the poster clear of its lettering (srcCrop on its manifest line, information only), unedited; converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The folder keeps lane C's slug (09); as installed it is Land 7 in the factory's numbering (levels 480-500, era 15) and Zen World 8.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 5; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair, trimmed to the 3 sheets 21 levels use. Kinds for a park: woodpile (a campfire), raven, grass, owl, mushrooms.

zen.note: v7 lane D: National Park Posters plays as Zen World 8 (tools/land.js ... zen writes tools/build-data/levels/zen.json only). Records keep the land factory numbers 480-502 (scratch/state.json seeded {from: 480, sheet0: 64, gal0: 62}: Worlds 1-7 hold 1-50, 201-250, 251-300, 301-350, 351-400, 401-429, 430-479; World 7's sheets end at 63); the page shows them on from World 7's last Zen number (Zen 330-350, main.js zenNum); zen.numbered keys each licence row by its Zen picture number before its level.

profile.note: Zen World 8, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-13): World 6 The Floating World's profile as it ships (tools/lands/07-floating-world/land.json; real art, max-box boards): tags in World 6's short-world shares (0.36 / 0.50 / 0.14) for E8/N10/H3 at 21, ending on a Hard; ? cards, linked squads, gentle moats (2 ways in) only on posters that can carry and deal one; no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08); careful floor 0.5 every tag; World 5's deal setting for max-box boards (squads 1.6x, 400 attempts).

tags.note: A 21-level world (lane C aa512c7 less np019 and np020, dropped): World 6's round 5 shares (0.36 / 0.50 / 0.14) give E8/N10/H3 at 21 (land-plan landTags), ending on a Hard.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

deal.note: World 5's and 6's shipped deal setting (tools/land-06-notes.md §2): squads 1.6x the land default and 400 deal attempts a candidate; kept for the posters, real-art max-box boards like World 6's.

mainNote: Lane C's order (picks-full.json landMain, workspace aa512c7) less two boards that fit no slot, dropped as lane C pre-agreed (no spares: the world shrinks rather than pads; orchestrator, 2026-10-13): np019 Zoo Elephant (too easy at any band: 96-100% random-tap wins at the land's and the default squads, and 100% in an Easy slot) and np020 Zoo Hippo (too easy and too short: 100% on most candidates, real pace 91-140 s on every one, with or without its ring). Their manifest lines stay. 21 levels. One reorder (lane D, the brief allows two slots): 488 and 489 trade places, so 488 = np015 Protect Your Parks (Normal, a link) and 489 = np040 Fire Wrecks a Forest (Easy, plain): at 488 (Normal) np040 won 100% of random-tap games on 22 of 24 candidates and the in-band two failed the fast tapper; it baked ok as an Easy in the 23-level plan.

map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. tools/map-plan-v7.md section 5: the castle sheets 9 (The Ironhollows: cliffs and a meadow) and 8 (the peaks) reused through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under a high-contrast warm ochre with the pines kept dark, the flat sunlit look of a 1930s WPA poster; 8's waterfall goes pale cream. 21 levels on 3 sheets (8 + 8 + 5).
